label: AWS EC2 infrastructure connector
summary: Map explicitly selected AWS account and regional resources into reviewed node provisioning and inventory workflows.
core_boundary: Platform retains native node admission; EC2 metadata and cloud credentials never become a root command channel. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Bind every instance, volume and network reference to an admitted account, region and WCP resource owner.
Exercise idempotent create/inspect requests, throttling, lost acknowledgements and out-of-order completion.
Refuse termination or detachment of foreign resources and require an explicit retained-volume decision.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
